name: Object-space decomposition with local clustering
definition: The k-way partitioning performed in each processor Pk effectively constitutes a K-way global clustering solution C = [C1, C2, ..., CK].
summary: Object-space decomposition with local clustering is a view-independent preprocessing method that partitions unstructured grids into cell-clusters using local MeTiS partitioning to minimize communication and load imbalance during parallel volume rendering.
